title: Precedent: on the Mac
summary: Native habits people already have. What each does, and what we'd borrow (the cards that borrow it are in brackets).

checks.text: Mail: Native mailbox list, keys and windows; each message in a web view. We borrow: native chrome, card bodies in a web view (Native SwiftUI, a web page, or b…)
Fantastical and Things: A whole small app in a menu-bar popover; Quick Entry from anywhere. We borrow: answer the next card from the menu bar (Answer from the menu bar)

Xcode: The Organizer window, the assistant editor beside your code, Open Quickly. We borrow: the Boards window, a pane beside the terminal, ⌘K (One board, three shapes, depend…; The board as a pane beside the agen…; Spotlight, Shortcuts and ⌘K find…)
Raycast: Menu-bar commands that show a live count. We borrow: one number in the menu bar (Answer from the menu bar)

why: These are the native habits the board should feel like. Each one is a pattern people already know, not something we'd have to teach.

options.label: Looks right
options.then: Keep these as the models the cards cite, and build to them.

options.label: One's wrong for us
options.sub: say which, and why, in the note
